title: Merge Intervals
description: Given an array of intervals [start, end], merge all overlapping intervals and return the non-overlapping intervals that cover all input intervals.

reference.use_case: Combining overlapping time ranges into consolidated blocks, such as merging calendar events to compute someone's busy time.
system_examples: Google Calendar free/busy — consolidating overlapping events into busy blocks
bedtools merge — combining overlapping genomic intervals
SLA reporting — merging overlapping outage windows to compute total downtime
reference.explanation: Sorting by start time makes overlapping intervals adjacent, so one pass that either extends the current block or starts a new one merges everything in O(n log n). Interval merging appears throughout scheduling, downtime accounting, and genomic range data.
